scope: Read-only original H1 input/output, arithmetic and delivery audit; no LLM, ORCA, task script, or product scientific checker executed.

selection_reasons.method: PBE0 is an allowed hybrid functional and remains consistent with the requested restricted Kohn-Sham (RKS) singlet state; for a 3-atom HCN system the cost is negligible under the frozen 4-core/192 MB-per-process limits, while hybrid DFT generally gives a balanced description for GIAO shielding.
selection_reasons.basis: def2-TZVP is an allowed triple-zeta basis with polarization functions, appropriate for magnetic shielding and still inexpensive for three atoms. This records the pre-calculation choice and cost basis before any ORCA execution.

actual_conditions.condition_verification: explicit input selectors only; all modifiers retained, output not independently verified

coordinate_frame.description: Unrotated Cartesian X/Y/Z frame of the exact input XYZ; total tensor before the separate diagonalized sT*s/orientation block; no symmetrization.

preparation_seed_fact.generation_reproducibility: no seed exposed; reuse this immutable XYZ
preparation_seed_fact.guarantee: initial graph/atom mapping and finite geometry only; not optimized or ground-state certified

fixed_tolerances.definition: 预先固定的工程核对阈值，不是核磁实验准确度保证。

total_shielding_tensor.failure: 任一必需分量越界、缺项、核标签错误、单位/总分量含义错误即fail；参考不可得则unverified。

isotropic_shielding.failure: 任一核的抄录、同设置参考或trace/3一致性越界即fail；不以另一阈值放宽原始抄录。

geometry.reference_input_rule: exact original atom order and coordinate values
geometry.failure: 参考或屏蔽来自未声明的不同几何，不能评分通过。

print_tolerance_note: Each stdout tensor diagonal and isotropic field is printed to 0.001 ppm. Independent nearest-rounding errors permit <=0.001 ppm in trace/3 versus printed iso; this is not a physical accuracy estimate.
independent_same_settings_reference: unverified; no independent ORCA reference was authorized or performed by this audit

delivery_audit.atom_order_and_units: C0, N1, H2; ppm in every physical CSV column; Cartesian input frame in raw manifest
delivery_audit.isotropic_value_provenance: Task code computed each isotropic value as trace(property &STot)/3; it did not independently extract the stdout iso field. This audit independently compared against the raw stdout's printed Total iso and found all within the pre-existing 0.001 ppm tolerance.
delivery_audit.task_trace_check_limitation: The task assigns iso=trace/3 then subtracts trace/3, so its zero deviations/consistent flag are algebraic identities, not an independent printed-isotropic check. This audit does not upgrade that historical claim.
